items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: One fella met us once, he was preparing a parade, a fella called by a kid.

ctx.x: We'd rather come back, let me be rather. We'd rather, we'd rather be shouting, have a big flag and such that.

One fella met us once, he was preparing a parade, a fella called by a kid. He said, you think you'd rather have a good time here when you're supposed to die? You don't have a man. You don't have a man. Man had a flag, came across in the water, just walking all across the road. We'd be that shit. We'd rather be able to get people down to the hotel at the band playing them and come back to the band playing them and come back. Come back, come back, boog in there. We'd rather come back, we'd rather, be shouting, have…
Yes, sir. Just like New Orleans?
